Tasteful clean readable composition, all ears/feet/tail inside panels. A static appearance sheet only, not an animation atlas. Do not add accessories, extra tails, paw-pad diagrams, alternate palettes, or different species.
scope: Static character appearance sheet, not an animation atlas or game installation.
